study_identification_part.si4_title: Deep Normative Tractometry for Identifying Joint White Matter Macro- and Micro-structural Abnormalities in Alzheimer's Disease

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states research objectives. The Abstract describes the purpose as introducing the Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT) framework to detect along-tract micro- and macro-structural abnormalities in MCI and AD by learning the normative distribution from healthy controls. The Introduction further explains the scientific gap and purpose of applying normative modeling.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: This study introduces the Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT) framework, that encodes the joint distribution of both macrostructural and microstructural profiles of the brain white matter tracts through a variational autoencoder (VAE). By training on data from healthy controls, DNT learns the normative distribution of tract data, and can delineate along-tract micro- and macro-structural abnormalities.

nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: Preprocessing steps for all DWI volumes included: denoising using local principal component analysis [23], Gibbs ringing removal [24], [25], correction of susceptibility-induced distortion [26], eddy currents [27] and bias field inhomogeneity [28]. Diffusion tensors were fitted with non-linear least-squares to produce fractional anisotropy (FA) and medial diffusivity (MD) scalar maps... Fiber orientations were reconstructed using Robust and Unbiased Model-BAsed Spherical Deconvolution (RUMBA-SD) [29], [30]. Particle filtering tracking [31] was using to generate whole-brain tractograms... TractoInferno was selected as the pretraining dataset in this study, as it contains multi-site single-shell acquisitions and has been carefully quality controlled.

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: Combined with the 3D spatial coordinates, each streamline, of size 128 × 5, was used as input to the ConvVAE model to jointly model both bundle geometry and microstructure. The model had an asymmetric architecture, with a 4-layer encoder, a 3-layer decoder, and a latent dimension of 64. Depthwise separable convolution [38] was used in each layer to accommodate a deeper feature space with efficient use of model parameters. The model, containing 454,742 trainable parameters, was pretrained for 29,000 steps, with a batch size of 512 on the TractoInferno dataset.

We corrected for multiple comparisons using the same FDR approach as the one used for BUAN...
